etsy.title: Kids Christmas Wish List Printable, Letter to Santa for Kids, Thank You Notes for Kids, Want Need Share List, Ages 3 to 10
etsy.description:
A calm wish list that keeps it to three: something I want, something I need, something to share. 🎄

WHAT'S INSIDE (8 pages)
• How-to page for grown-ups
• Letter to Santa for ages 3–5 (draw or glue your wishes)
• Letter to Santa for ages 5–7 (big lines)
• Letter to Santa for ages 7–10 (with "something kind I did this year")
• 12 thank-you notes for after Christmas (write or draw)
• Grown-up gift tracker

Ages 3 to 10.

INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped.
You get 2 PDFs: US Letter and A4. Print at home or at a print shop. For personal use only.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
